title: Choose a threshold from production consequences
description: Move the decision threshold and review capacity. The same score distribution produces different precision, recall, operational load, and expected error cost.

scenarios.label: Payment fraud review
scenarios.detail: Rare positives; a missed fraud case is far more expensive than an unnecessary review.

scenarios.label: Abuse moderation queue
scenarios.detail: Harmful content is uncommon, but reviewers have a strict daily queue budget.

scenarios.label: Churn intervention
scenarios.detail: Positives are common and outreach is cheap, so recall can matter more than a very pure queue.
